# home

Program and service options are Home Manager's: see the [Home Manager options](https://home-manager-options.extranix.com/). Usage: [Linux and macOS helpers](../reference/nix.md).

## home()

Any Home Manager options, as an object: `home({ programs: { ... } })`.

```ts
home(config: HomeOptions): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## home.imports()

Import Home Manager modules (`home-manager` module paths or `inputs.x.homeManagerModules.y`).

```ts
home.imports(imports: string[]): Fragment
home.imports(...imports: string[]): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## home.program()

Enable a Home Manager program, with its options: `programs.<name>` with
`enable = true`. Installs the program and writes its config.

```ts
home.program("git", { settings: { user: { name: "Alice" } } });
```

```ts
home.program(name: string, opts?: ProgramOptions<HomeProgramOptions, K>): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## home.service()

Enable a Home Manager service, with its options: `services.<name>` with `enable = true`.

```ts
home.service(name: string, opts?: ServiceOptions<HomeServiceOptions, K>): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## home.packages()

Install packages for the user (`home.packages`), by nixpkgs attribute name
or `nix.pkg(...)`/`nix.binaryRelease(...)`.

```ts
home.packages("ripgrep", "fd");
```

```ts
home.packages(packages: PackageRef[]): Fragment
home.packages(...packages: PackageRef[]): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## home.configFile()

One file in ~/.config (`xdg.configFile`).

```ts

```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## home.configFiles()

Files in ~/.config (`xdg.configFile`), by path relative to it.

```ts
home.configFiles({ "lazygit/config.yml": home.symlink("./dotfiles/lazygit/config.yml") });
```

```ts
home.configFiles(files: Record<string, HomeFile>): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## home.symlink()

Out-of-store symlink source. `~/` paths are home-relative; `./` and
`../` paths are relative to the directory holding winix.config.ts.

```ts
home.symlink(path: string, opts?: Omit<HomeFile, "source" | "text">): HomeFile
```

## home.raw()

A raw Nix snippet added to the Home Manager module, as written.

```ts

```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## home.activation()

A Home Manager activation script (`home.activation.<name>`), run on every switch.

```ts
home.activation(name: string, opts: ActivationOpts): Fragment
```

**`opts`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `after?` | `string[]` | DAG dependencies. Defaults to ["writeBoundary"]. |
| `script` | `string` | Shell script body. Nix interpolations such as ${config.home.homeDirectory} are passed through. |

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## home.wsl

Home Manager helpers for NixOS-WSL hosts.

### home.wsl.gitCredentialManager()

Use the Windows Git Credential Manager from WSL: enables
`programs.git` and sets `credential.helper` to a shim that finds
Git for Windows' GCM at run time.

```ts
home.wsl.gitCredentialManager(opts?: HomeWslGitCredentialManagerOpts): Fragment
```

**`opts`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paths?` | `readonly string[]` | Windows paths to try, in order. Defaults to Git for Windows' ucrt64/mingw64 GCM. |

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.
